provenance_audit: Audit against the official UCI Cleveland Clinic repository demonstrates that this 1,025-row dataset was constructed by replicating rows from the original 303-row UCI dataset. Out of 1,025 rows, 723 are exact duplicates.
data_leakage_risk: Severe risk of data leakage: if random train/test splits are applied without deduplication, identical patient instances appear in both training and test partitions, creating artificially inflated accuracy (e.g. >98%) and AUROC that fail to reflect real-world generalization.
designated_role: Demonstration benchmark for data-quality audits and duplicate-detection algorithms ONLY.
intended_use: Demonstrating the necessity of data-quality checks, duplicate-detection rules, and leakage audits in medical machine learning pipelines.
forbidden_use: Model training, model evaluation, benchmarking clinical accuracy, or claiming improved model performance.
